legacy.title: LineGuard found
legacy.description: HomeLines succeeds LineGuard. You can take over settings, device groups, counters and outage history. Remove LineGuard afterwards.

user.title: Set up HomeLines
user.description: Monitors your internet lines and controls cellular backup. Choose how HomeLines blocks devices at your router.

unifi.title: Connect UniFi
unifi.description: Create the API key in UniFi under Settings → Control Plane → Integrations. HomeLines creates and maintains a policy-based route “HomeLines Notbetrieb”.

switches.title: Switch per device
switches.description: Switches that allow (on) or block (off) a device’s internet access, e.g. from the FRITZ!Box integration.

scripts.title: Custom scripts
scripts.description: Scripts receive the variables devices and macs with the devices to block.

legacy_running.title: LineGuard is still running
legacy_running.description: HomeLines has taken over the LineGuard setup. Remove LineGuard under Settings → Devices & services and delete custom_components/lineguard. HomeLines then removes the old router rule.

primary_wan_missing.title: Primary line not found on router
primary_wan_missing.description: The line “{name}” used for the block rule no longer exists in UniFi. Choose it again under HomeLines → Configure → Lines.
